fools-flight.short: Charge an enemy that Fell Back
fools-flight.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit finishes a fall-back move.
fools-flight.target: One friendly unengaged LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE unit within 6" of that enemy unit.
fools-flight.effect: Your unit declares a charge. Its charge targets must be enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.

ruleParts.name: Beguiling Aura
ruleParts.text: LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH units from your army are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

ruleParts.name: Seductive Gambit
ruleParts.text: Each time a LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit from your army ends a Charge move, it can perform a Seductive Gambit: until the end of the turn it loses Fights First, but its attacks can re-roll the Hit roll and re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

addStratagems.name: RAPTUROUS AGONY
addStratagems.short: -1 to wound vs attacks stronger than your Toughness
addStratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units).
addStratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a Strength greater than its Toughness have -1 to Wound rolls.

foetid-resurgence.effect: Return up to 1 destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) to your unit with its full wounds remaining, or up to D3 such models if it is a BATTLELINE unit. If your unit is a MONSTER unit, one model in it regains up to D3+1 lost wounds instead.

ruleParts.name: Thralls of the First Prince
ruleParts.text: Your army cannot include DAEMON PRINCE, DAEMON PRINCE WITH WINGS or EPIC HERO units other than BE'LAKOR. It can include certain HERETIC ASTARTES units (up to 500 pts at Incursion, 1000 pts at Strike Force, 1500 pts at Onslaught). LEGIONES DAEMONICA units gain the SHADOW LEGION keyword; BE'LAKOR and HERETIC ASTARTES units gain SHADOW LEGION and UNDIVIDED.

ruleParts.name: Murderer's Cowl
ruleParts.text: SHADOW LEGION KHORNE units are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced.

ruleParts.name: Penumbral Puppetry
ruleParts.text: SHADOW LEGION TZEENTCH units have Stealth, and melee attacks that target them have -1 to Hit rolls.

ruleParts.name: Gloam Rot
ruleParts.text: SHADOW LEGION NURGLE units: attacks with a Strength greater than the unit's Toughness have -1 to Wound rolls against them.

ruleParts.name: Shadow's Caress
ruleParts.text: SHADOW LEGION SLAANESH units cannot be targeted by snap shooting attacks.

ruleParts.name: Disciples of Be'lakor
ruleParts.text: SHADOW LEGION UNDIVIDED units have the Dark Pacts army rule from Codex: Chaos Space Marines (BE'LAKOR automatically passes its Leadership test). SHADOW LEGION HERETIC ASTARTES models also have Deep Strike.

shade-path.short: -1 to a nearby enemy's Charge rolls
shade-path.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
shade-path.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, it has -1 to Charge rolls. If your unit has the NURGLE keyword, that enemy unit must also make a battle-shock roll.

ruleParts.name: Unholy Avalanche
ruleParts.text: A friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED unit that made a fall-back move this turn is still eligible to shoot and to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: From Beyond the Veil
stratagems.short: A Mounted unit in reserves makes an ingress move
stratagems.when: End of the Movement phase, from the start of the battle.
stratagems.target: One friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED unit in Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make an ingress move.

stratagems.name: Warp-riders
stratagems.short: Mounted unit gains MOBILE as it moves
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED unit is selected to move.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has the MOBILE keyword.

stratagems.name: Inescapable Manifestations
stratagems.short: Enemies falling back from your unit must desperately escape
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when a unit engaged with a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.effect: An enemy unit engaged with your unit that is selected to make a fall-back move must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is battle-shocked, subtract 1 from those hazard rolls.

ruleParts.name: Loci of Power
ruleParts.text: Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER models (excluding MONSTER models) have +1 Ld and OC.

stratagems.name: Carnival of Excess
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER SLAANESH unit (excluding MONSTER units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: Call to Murder
stratagems.short: +1 A to a charging Khorne character's melee
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE CHARACTER unit (excluding MONSTER units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER KHORNE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have +1 A.

stratagems.name: Skirling Magicks
stratagems.short: Tzeentch character's ranged attacks gain [LETHAL HITS]
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER TZEENTCH unit (excluding MONSTER units) is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER TZEENTCH unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Bilious Blessing
stratagems.short: Roll 7D6; each 4+ deals 1 MW to a nearby enemy
stratagems.target: One friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER NURGLE unit (excluding MONSTER units).
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 8" of your unit and roll seven D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

ruleParts.name: Shudderblink
ruleParts.text: When a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit is selected to make an Advance move: That unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn. That move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Soulseeing
stratagems.short: +6" detection range on an enemy unit
stratagems.target: One friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

stratagems.name: Incorporeal Entities
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Daemonic Infestation
stratagems.target: One friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit (excluding PINK HORRORS units).

ruleParts.name: Warp Rifts
ruleParts.text: Each time a LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within your army's Shadow of Chaos, and/or if it is set up wholly within 6" of one or more friendly BLOODTHIRSTER, GREAT UNCLEAN ONE, KAIROS FATEWEAVER, KEEPER OF SECRETS, LORD OF CHANGE, ROTIGUS, SHALAXI HELBANE or SKARBRAND units with which it shares the KHORNE, TZEENTCH, NURGLE or SLAANESH keyword, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models, instead of more than 8".

stratagems.name: Corrupt Realspace
stratagems.short: Corrupt an objective: hold it + 6" Shadow of Chaos
stratagems.target: One LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker is Corrupted and remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn. In addition, while an objective marker is Corrupted and under your control, the area of the battlefield within 6" of it is considered to be within your army's Shadow of Chaos.

stratagems.name: Warp Surge
stratagems.short: Charge after Advancing (in Shadow of Chaos)
stratagems.target: One LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army that is within your army's Shadow of Chaos.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Draught of Terror
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1. In addition, until the end of the phase, each time such a weapon targets a unit that is Battle-shocked, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Denizens of the Warp
stratagems.target: One LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.

stratagems.name: The Realm of Chaos
stratagems.short: Pull units into Reserves to redeploy
stratagems.target: Up to two LEGIONES DAEMONICA units from your army that are within your army's Shadow of Chaos, or one other LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Place the targeted units into Strategic Reserves. Each must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units with this Stratagem.

stratagems.name: Daemonic Invulnerability
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of that enemy unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an invulnerable saving throw is made for a model in your unit, re-roll a saving throw of 1.
